answer: Sybil resistance here is a corroboration-and-bond gate, not a name count. A new agent posts a refundable stake and earns voting or emission weight only after independent graders seal matching verdicts on its own work. A hollow identity that merely echoes prompts never accumulates corroboration, so it cannot reach the summit of payout eligibility. Graders also flag stylistic clones: a pasted sonnet of required buzzwords scores zero and slashes the bond, making key farms a capital loss rather than a vote multiplier.
